FormModule.Name: CONF_03_QUERY_CASCADE
FormModule.Title: Query Cascade and Resumable Alert Conformance

Alert.Name: CONFIRM_DELETE
Alert.Title: Confirm Cancellation
Alert.AlertMessage: Are you sure you want to cancel this order?
Alert.Message: Are you sure you want to cancel this order?

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText: DECLARE v_button NUMBER; BEGIN v_button := SHOW_ALERT('CONFIRM_DELETE'); IF v_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN :ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS := 'CANCELLED'; MESSAGE('Order cancelled.'); END IF; END;
